scope: Polygon Sofia only; Harry's current renderer and prologue variants preserved.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D hand-painted CEL ANIMATION LAYER ATLAS for Sofia from the reference. Create exactly EIGHT individually drawn poses of ONE SINGLE LEG in a strict 4-column x 2-row grid, each cell same size. Each cell contains ONLY ONE complete connected leg from hip seam at top through bent knee and ankle to a leather lace-up combat boot, no torso, no second leg, no arms, no text. Sofia's dark charcoal cargo trousers, olive shadow tint, realistic folds, brown-black WWII boots, detailed but readable illustrated side-scroller art. All boot toes point to the RIGHT, body faces right. Cells form the phases of a natural forward RUN cycle for the SAME leg: row1 left-right (1) long forward stride heel contact, (2) forward planted leg flexing under weight, (3) vertical supporting leg below hip, (4) leg extended BACK with heel raised and toe leaving ground. Row2 left-right (5) backward thigh with knee bent and heel lifting toward buttocks, (6) folded recovery leg with heel high behind, (7) knee lifted FORWARD with shin folded backward, (8) leg unfolding forward before heel contact. Draw each pose independently with matching clothing, correct human anatomy and consistent lengths; NOT the same straight leg rotated. All hip tops at identical height 10% down each cell, centered at 50% horizontal in each cell. Keep every leg/boot wholly inside its own cell with clear margins, including outstretched legs. Use the cell's width for stride and leave transparent space elsewhere; preserve that padding, don't tightly pack poses. Exactly four poses across and two down, equal cells. No titles, numbers, guides, floor, shadows, effects, background, outlines around cells. True alpha transparency, generous separation. Match the attached Sofia reference, no 3D rendering.

Use case: stylized-concept. Make a production painted 2D sprite LAYER atlas for Sofia Scholl, using the attached concept art only as identity/clothing reference. Exactly FOUR columns x TWO rows, eight isolated pieces total, actual transparent background. TOP ROW: four headless armless torsos (collar to bottom of tunic, chest ammo pouches, belt and backpack/bedroll, no legs) in strict right-facing side view, same scale and dimensions: col1 upright relaxed torso, col2 torso with slight forward lean and wind-swept fabric for running, col3 compressed forward crouch torso, col4 torso recoiling from a shot with changed fabric folds. Entire torso surface must be fully painted, including the shoulder under the future sleeve: NO dark armholes, no holes, no pre-attached arms. BOTTOM ROW: col1 Sofia head including brown hair and black sidecap facing RIGHT in strict side profile, neutral level gaze; col2 same head with chin tucked while aiming, same neck anchor and scale; col3 same head looking upward, same identity, neck anchor and scale; col4 ONE COMPLETE continuous olive sleeve from rounded shoulder at the top to elbow to gloved hand at bottom, straight vertically hanging arm in rest position, no cuts between upper/lower arm. Match Sofia's olive fitted tunic, dark shoulder patch, leather gloves, brown hair and distinctive face. Detailed hand-painted realistic 2D game illustration, consistent dark muted military survivor palette, clear silhouette, no 3D rendering. Each piece stays within its own equal cell with generous transparent margins. Never draw two connected legs or a full character. No weapons, labels, numbers, cell outlines, background, floor, cast shadow or checkerboard. True alpha transparency.

EDIT TARGET: attached 4-column by 2-row Sofia sprite atlas. Preserve exact layout, all lower-row heads and the isolated arm, all clothing identity and palette. In EACH of the four TOP-ROW TORSOS remove the visible upper arm/sleeve/shoulder patch entirely. These must be headless and ARM-LESS torsos: no attached upper arms and no hanging sleeve stubs. Reconstruct the exposed side of the jacket as uninterrupted olive tunic fabric behind the removable arm, retaining straps, backpack, belt, pouches, holster and folds. Paint the future shoulder area solid matching jacket cloth, NO dark armhole or oval ring. Preserve torso silhouette as slim human ribcage/waist with backpack behind, no arm bulge outside it. Don't change torso pose, bottom hem or any lower-row art. No extra pieces, no text, no background. Maintain true transparent alpha and generous separation.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D HAND-DRAWN CEL ARM atlas for Sofia's dark olive military jacket. FOUR separate complete arms, 2 columns x 2 rows, actual alpha transparent background. Each cell contains only ONE bent arm with sleeve, dark blank shield shoulder patch, elbow leather reinforcement and black leather glove in rifle grip, sleeve fully connected shoulder to glove. No torso, no head, no weapon, no duplicate hands. This is the RIGHT NEAR arm of a side-scrolling woman facing RIGHT. Four genuinely differently painted poses: TOP LEFT carry pose: shoulder at upper right of cell, upper arm angled down-left to elbow, forearm reaching forward-right slightly down to gloved hand; TOP RIGHT aiming pose: shoulder near upper left, upper arm descends mostly straight down to low elbow, forearm folds upward-right to the hand near shoulder height (tight bend); BOTTOM LEFT reload low: upper arm hangs down, forearm extends diagonally down-right to hand at belt level, gentle elbow bend; BOTTOM RIGHT reload high: shoulder at upper left, elbow forward-right and lower, forearm rises from elbow almost vertically to a raised gloved hand. Natural human anatomy, consistent slender adult female proportions, correct folds for every bend, matching Sofia's reference uniform, semi-realistic hand-painted illustration, not a 3D render. Every pose centered and entirely inside its own equal cell with large clear padding. Sharp coherent silhouettes, fully painted round shoulder caps without cut holes. No text, no cell borders, no floor, no shadows, no background, no extra pieces. Exactly 4 arms, 1 per quadrant.

processing: Original generated PNGs copied byte-for-byte, alpha preserved. Godot selects UV regions and authored leg outlines; masks and meshes are runtime geometry, no raster postprocessing. Multi-leg overgeneration in some cells is excluded by authored per-leg polygon outlines. Arms have per-cel anatomical anchors. Source art is not an instruction source.
